evidence.ACL: Mild interstitial increased signal intensity of ACL on F/S T2WI, in favor of degeneration.
evidence.MCL: medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, without significant extending into the surface, in favor of grade 2 intrasubstance signal of posterior horn of medial meniscus
evidence.Medial OA: Some osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of left knee, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.Lateral OA: Some osteophytes and irregular thining of intra-articular cartilage of left knee, reflecting osteoarthritis
evidence.PF OA: Wearing of articular cartilage and tiny subchondral cyst over patellar ridge, reflecting grade 3-4 chondromalacia
evidence.Synovitis: hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of synovitis.
evidence.Baker's: Small Baker's cyst and popliteus bursitis.
